topics.topic: Authoritative source of current formal invariants when decisions and historical ledger rows differ
questions: Which text is the authoritative current set of formal invariants when the historical ledger, the unspecified "Status above", and the decisions differ?

Which text is authoritative when a decision and a retained ledger row differ, and where are the current formal invariants identified now that the overview no longer says the decisions' Formal invariants are current?

Which source is authoritative when a ledger row retained as historical evidence differs from the wording distributed into a decision, and must an implementer ignore every withdrawn ledger requirement?

quotes:
Migrated on 2026-11-06 from the former `spec/20_rules.md` (`SOURCE.md`). Each former
rule table R1–R17 is one indexed accepted decision A1–A17 whose `Normative rules` are
the former text verbatim; the former invariant ledger (`spec/invariant_ledger.json`,
kept as evidence) is distributed into each decision's `Formal invariants`; ledger rows
no table carries form A18–A21.

`invariant_ledger.json` is the evidence of 2026-07-19 whose rows were
distributed into the decisions (Status above). It keeps wording the owner
withdrew with the email challenges (R0-23): the verified email of INV-001
and INV-014, the challenge tokens of INV-003 and INV-004, and INV-010…INV-013
and INV-016.
judgement.why: The Status identifies the ledger as historical evidence and the accepted decisions' Formal invariants as the destinations of its rows, while expressly identifying the retained challenge wording as withdrawn.

topics.topic: Classification, range, ownership, and landing assignment of INV-016
questions: Why is INV-016 described inside the INV-001…INV-015 row, and does it belong to that row's area, owning responsibilities, and landing or have no current assignment because it was removed?
Is INV-016 part of the IAM range and ownership entry despite lying outside INV-001…INV-015, or is it intentionally outside every listed ID range?
Does “every invariant” include the withdrawn and removed invariants that the evidence still retains, and if so what single owning responsibility does INV-016 have?
Why is INV-016 declared removed inside the INV-001…INV-015 row, and which area, owning responsibility, and expected landing apply to INV-016 if it remains a formal invariant or retained identifier?
Where is the single owner of each invariant identified when the overview assigns an ID range to several responsibilities separated by semicolons?

quotes:
On 2026-11-07 the owner removed the staff email challenges (`00_product.md` R0-23):
A10 states that the portal has none; the challenge rows of A3, A11 and A13, the
challenge settings of A30 and the invariants INV-010, INV-011, INV-012, INV-013 and
INV-016 are removed, and A3/A4 no longer require a verified email to authenticate.

| INV-001…INV-015 | IAM: sessions, capabilities, secrets (INV-010…INV-013 and INV-016, the email challenges, removed 2026-11-07, R0-23) | authorization guard; authentication flows; credential storage | notes (+ rules for capability/transition tables; properties where pure) |

With it go `rules.email_challenge_policy` and the invariants
INV-010, INV-012, INV-013 and INV-016 (`open_questions.md` Q19, closed).

Every invariant names exactly one owning responsibility; policy data behind
an invariant lives in the rules tables below, not in prose.
judgement.why: INV-016 is mentioned parenthetically in the IAM row solely as a removed challenge invariant, so it is not a current invariant requiring a range assignment, owner, landing, or Required tests item.

topics.topic: Scope of the withdrawal of verified-email requirements versus the retained recorded email-verified mark
questions: Was only challenge-dependent verified-email wording in INV-001 and INV-014 withdrawn, or were the invariants concerning the recorded "email verified" mark also withdrawn despite R0-20 and R0-23 requiring that mark to be set and shown?
Does “verified email” mean the removed email-verification requirement, the still-required recorded “email verified” mark from R0-23, or both?
Was all verified-email content in INV-001 and INV-014 withdrawn, or only challenge-related or authorization effects while the recorded, visible, inert “email verified” mark required by R0-23 remains?

quotes:
It keeps wording the owner
withdrew with the email challenges (R0-23): the verified email of INV-001
and INV-014, the challenge tokens of INV-003 and INV-004, and INV-010…INV-013
and INV-016.

The row `Challenges/tokens: issued → consumed | expired | revoked` is removed
with the challenges, and authentication no longer requires a verified email
besides `active` status (owner 2026-11-07, `00_product.md` R0-23). Every path
into `active` records the email as verified (activation, R0-07), so the answer
to every account stays the one the accepted spec gave.

A staff account keeps a recorded "email verified" mark: the administrator's
activation, the first administrator's creation (R0-07) and the recovery
override (R0-20) set it, and the account view shows it. The mark grants and
refuses nothing; an account signs in while it is active.
judgement.why: The withdrawn wording is the verified-email authentication condition, while the texts separately and expressly retain the inert recorded mark, require every path into active to set it, and require the account view to show it.

topics.topic: Row-by-row invariant status and its implementation and testing consequences
questions: What status applies to each retained ledger row, especially INV-001, INV-003, INV-004, INV-010…INV-014 and INV-016, and what implementation or test consequence does each status have?
What is “Status above,” and where does it identify, row by row, whether a ledger row is current, narrowed, replaced, or removed?

Are INV-003, INV-004, INV-010…INV-013, and INV-016 removed formal invariants, retained identifiers with replacement non-challenge wording, or current requirements whose old ledger wording is merely marked historical?
Do retained-but-withdrawn ledger rows require Required tests items, or are Required tests required only for the replacement current formal invariants in the decisions?

quotes:
On 2026-11-07 the owner removed the staff email challenges (`00_product.md` R0-23):
A10 states that the portal has none; the challenge rows of A3, A11 and A13, the
challenge settings of A30 and the invariants INV-010, INV-011, INV-012, INV-013 and
INV-016 are removed, and A3/A4 no longer require a verified email to authenticate.

`invariant_ledger.json` is the evidence of 2026-07-19 whose rows were
distributed into the decisions (Status above). It keeps wording the owner
withdrew with the email challenges (R0-23): the verified email of INV-001
and INV-014, the challenge tokens of INV-003 and INV-004, and INV-010…INV-013
and INV-016.
- INV-014: a staff account authenticates only in active status; pending_verification cannot log in

- INV-001: every project-scoped operation passes the guard sequence: valid session, active principal, project access, required capability, Registry lifecycle policy; first failure wins
- INV-004: authentication flows never reveal account or viewer existence; auth failures never expose project data
- INV-003: passwords, session tokens, viewer access tokens and service credentials are stored only in verification/hash form and never logged
judgement.why: The Status enumerates the removed invariants, the overview identifies which old ledger wording was withdrawn, and the decisions contain the replacement current Formal invariants and their Required tests items.

topics.topic: Whether withdrawn and removed ledger rows were distributed into the decisions
questions: Does “whose rows were distributed into the decisions” include the withdrawn and removed rows, or were only surviving rows distributed?
